_comment: Turkish terms chosen for the lesson other-models. status: sourced = attested in at least two Turkish scholarly sources I opened; chosen = my own choice among attested variants or my own rendering; check = weakly attested (blogs, translations of McQuail) or my own translation, needs a Turkish-language reviewer. Turkish sources opened: Nesterova Coşkun 2023 (nesterova-coskun-2023), Dalak 2021 (dalak-2021), Karagöz 2007 (a Turkish journal article on the Qur’an’s style and the functions of language, read but not cited), Iplikci 2015, Yaylagul 2006, and a Turkish blog summary of Maletzke (not cited). No term comes from any institution's course text.

jakobson-functions.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023 says the doctrine is mostly called 'iletişim şeması'; the spelling 'Jacobson' also occurs in Turkish (e.g. in titles) and is listed as a variant.

speech-event-factors.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023 uses 'etken' and 'faktör' side by side.

addressee.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023: alıcı, muhatap; Dalak 2021: gönderilen (alıcı).

context.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023: bağlam (= referent); Dalak 2021 lists the factor as 'gönderge'.

contact.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023 calls the factor 'kanal' and the function 'kanal teyidi' (also 'irtibat teyidi'); 'temas' is a literal rendering of 'contact' chosen for clarity and flagged for review.

referential-function.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023; Karagöz 2007 also 'göndergesel işlev'; Dalak 2021: 'gönderge işlevi'.

emotive-function.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023, Karagöz 2007: duygusal; Dalak 2021: duygu.

conative-function.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023, Dalak 2021, Karagöz 2007 all: çağrı.

poetic-function.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023: poetik; Karagöz 2007: sanatsal; Dalak 2021: şiir/sanat.

phatic-function.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023: kanal teyidi (also irtibat teyidi); Karagöz 2007 and Dalak 2021: ilişki işlevi. The transliteration 'fatik' was not seen in the Turkish articles I opened; it is my rendering and flagged for review.

metalingual-function.note: Nesterova Coşkun 2023: metadil; Karagöz 2007 and Dalak 2021: üstdil.

gerbner-model.note: Iplikci 2015 writes 'Gerbner Modeli (1956)'; 'genel iletişim modeli' is my translation of Gerbner's own title 'a general model of communication'.

maletzke-model.note: 'Maletzke modeli' is the usual Turkish short form (blogs and lecture notes); 'alan şeması' is my literal rendering of the German 'Feldschema'. I found no Turkish scholarly article that fixes the term, so it is flagged for a Turkish reviewer.

communicator.note: 'iletici' was seen in a search snippet of a Turkish translation of McQuail and Windahl (page not opened); a Turkish lecture-notes blog I opened writes 'gönderici'. The lesson uses 'iletici' for Maletzke and 'gönderici' for Jakobson; flagged for a Turkish reviewer.

statement.note: Aussage is 'statement'; Turkish texts use ileti/gönderi.

para-feedback.note: Ioni & Pstae 2017 write 'para-feedback'; 'zayıf geri bildirim' is the McQuail-Turkish rendering of 'weak feedback'. Both are flagged for review.

medium-constraint.en: constraint of the medium (Zwang des Mediums)
medium-constraint.note: A Turkish McQuail summary reads 'kitle iletişim aracından gelen baskı veya zorlama'.

riley-model.note: Yaylagül 2006 heads the section 'İletişime Sosyolojik Yaklaşım: Riley ve Riley Modeli'.
